chapter: Part One. Thermal Phenomena — Molecular Physics
section: 第二章　热力学基础
title: Avogadro's law

prose.text:
Early in the nineteenth century, scientists found that the volumes of gases taking part in chemical reactions often have simple whole-number ratios when compared at the same temperature and pressure.
Examples include $1:1$, $1:2$, and $1:3$.
In $1811$, Avogadro proposed that equal volumes of gases at the same temperature and pressure contain equal numbers of molecules.

This relation is called Avogadro's law.
It is exact for ideal gases.
For real gases, it is approximate only where the ideal-gas approximation applies.
prose.source_text: 十九世纪初建立了参与化学反应的气体的简单比例法则：相互化合的气体的体积，具有简单的比例：$1:1$；$1:2$；$1:3$ 等。根据这个法则，阿伏伽德罗在 $1881$ 年作出了一个大胆的假说：在相同的温度和压强下，相同体积的气体含有相同的分子数。目前，这个结论已得到证实，并叫做阿伏伽德罗定律。

prose.text:
According to Avogadro's law, at the same pressure $p$ and temperature $t$, $1$ mole of any ideal gas occupies the same volume.
This is because $1$ mole contains the same number of specified gas particles.

The original textbook calls these particles molecules;
for a monatomic gas, the entities counted are atoms.

In this lesson, the standard state specifically means temperature $0^\circ\mathrm{C}$ and pressure $101325$ N/m$^2$.
At this state, a commonly used approximate ideal-gas molar volume is:

$V_{0\mathrm{m}}=0.0224$ m$^3$/mol $=22.4$ L/mol.
(2-9)

This value is not a volume that remains unchanged at every temperature and pressure.
Always specify both conditions when comparing gas volumes.
prose.source_text: 根据阿伏伽德罗定律，在相同的压强 $p$ 和温度 $t$ 下，$1$ 摩尔的各种气体都具有相同的体积，因为 $1$ 摩尔的分子数是相同的。测量指出：在标准状态下，即当温度为 $0^\circ\mathrm{C}$ 和大气压为$101325$ 牛顿/米$^2$时，这个体积等于$V_{0\mathrm{м}}=0.0224$ 米$^3$/摩尔$=22.4$ 升/摩尔。　（2-9）

prose.text:
Here $V_{0\mathrm{m}}$ is the molar volume at the specified standard state.
Molar volume is volume per mole of gas, not the total volume of an arbitrary sample.
prose.source_text: 体积 $V_{0\mathrm{м}}$ 叫做摩尔体积。

prose.text:
Why do equal volumes of ideal gases at the same pressure and temperature contain equal numbers of particles, regardless of the gas species?
Kinetic theory can explain this relation.
Section $34$ discusses it further in terms of microscopic motion.
prose.source_text: 为什么在相同的压强和温度下相同体积的气体都具有相同的分子数，而与是什么气体没有关系呢？这只有利用分子运动论才能解释（参阅 § $34$）。
